bullets.text: Apple's Marathon Events - Apple promotes health products ahead of the TCS London Marathon with exciting pre-race activities.
Criminal Record Returns - Apple TV's gripping thriller Criminal Record season 2 premieres April 22 with strong early reviews.
Motorola Razr Fold Launch - Pre-orders for the innovative Motorola Razr Fold open in the UK, shipping on May 6.
Apple CarPlay Expands - New iOS update allows AI chatbot apps like Perplexity to integrate with CarPlay.
Apple's iPhone 18 Pro - Manufacturing begins for a new variable aperture camera feature in the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro.
Zoom's Human Verification - Zoom partners with World to ensure real human presence in meetings, combating deepfake fraud.
Gigs App Launch - New app Gigs helps users archive concert memories with AI, enhancing live music experiences.
Ecovacs' Robot Mower - Ecovacs' Goat A3000 Pro robot mower now includes a weed eater, enhancing its functionality.
